title: Claude Duet app is Anthropic’s bet on agents
slides: Is Anthropic's Claude Duet app betting on agents to replace your workflow?
The app pairs two Claude instances working in tandem on tasks
One silently critiques the other, catching errors before output
You can run both agents locally without cloud dependency
Pick one repetitive task and test Duet against your current method
thread_text:
1. Two Claudes, one task

Anthropic's Claude Duet runs two AI instances in tandem: one generates, the other silently critiques. Errors get caught before you ever see them.

2. The silent critic

While one Claude works, the second reviews every output in real time. It's like having a copyeditor who never sleeps and never misses a typo.

3. No cloud required

You can run both agents entirely on your local machine. No data leaves your device, no API calls, no latency.

4. Workflow under threat

Duet doesn't just assist—it aims to replace repetitive steps. If it works, your current process might be obsolete.

5. Test it yourself

Pick one repetitive task you do weekly. Run Duet against your usual method. Does it save time or just add review layers?
